papers.topic: From a known equation to unknown coefficients
papers.scope: 256 observations; joint field/coefficient fitting; clean/noisy/data-only controls; sensor identifiability. Teaching viscosity 0.05, time end 0.5.
Independent 1-D Poisson adaptation of sections 2.3 and 2.5; no reproduction of the 2-D benchmarks or gated architecture.
Independent periodic convection adaptation of sections 3.1 and 5.1. Adam, target beta 10; not the original benchmark or time-window sequence-to-sequence implementation.

Independent harmonic-oscillator ODE adaptation of section 3 residual weighting. Hard initial values, eight bins and a fixed training ceiling; not chaotic/turbulent benchmarks or full Algorithm 1 reproduction.

papers.paper: Yu, Lu, Meng & Karniadakis (2022), Gradient-enhanced physics-informed neural networks for forward and inverse PDE problems
papers.scope: Original 1-D Poisson equation and hard-endpoint ansatz, sections 2.2/3.2.1. Smaller network, 16/32 midpoint sets and 4000 updates; no inverse problem or RAR implementation.
